title: Figure 27. Titan Simulation Results with B = 1,000 (log-scale line graph)
description: Semi-log line graph titled "Titan IV Random-Attitude Failures through 300 sec" plotting Percent in 5-deg sector (%) against Angle From Flight Path (deg), 0–180. Simulated impact data for no breakup and breakup q-alpha 20,000, 10,000 and 5,000 are overlaid with theoretical curves for B = 1,000 and A = 2.00, 2.95, 3.25 and 3.50. Captioned "Figure 27. Titan Simulation Results with B = 1,000".
